claim_boundary: Logical and scheduled payload accounting only; no row is a physical HBM, cache-traffic, energy, or fused-kernel measurement.
grouping_policy: Generated groups do not cross batch examples: n=B*ceil(S/q), 1<=q<=S. Cached decode therefore uses S=q=1 and n=B.
source_policy: source_state_bytes conservatively charges source_passes complete B*S*d activation scans; an anchor-only implementation must be identified and accounted separately
controller_policy: The default controller is Linear(d,h)-SiLU-Linear(h,3r). Full-factor scheduled rows use the same explicitly reported controller traffic as a proxy overhead; their base ratio is the controller-independent feasibility boundary.
